test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 30 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following canal systems is NOT in Haryana?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gandak canal.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Eastern Gandak Canal Project was a start-up in 1960 and the **Main Canal system was completed in 1975**.
 
• A hydroelectric generating station with an installed capacity of** 15 MW(3x5 MW)** has already been constructed and commissioned on the fall of **5.3 m at RD 6.0** on by** pass to Eastern Gandak Canal.**
 
• The Gandak Project at Valmikinagar (Bhainsaloton) **intercepts water from a catchment area of 37,410 km (23,250 mi), which is mostly in Nepal and partly in India**.
 
• An agreement was signed on** 4 December 1959** between the governments of Nepal and of India.

 [IMAGE: https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcSER97b8if_bWuW8wVlCTdOv4QC9CeEyOIJEw&usqp=CAU] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Western Yamuna Canal is a **canal in the river Yamuna that was dug out and renovated in 1335 CE by Firoz Shah Tughlaq**.
 
• The Bhakra-Nangal dam is **one of the earliest river valley development schemes undertaken after the independence of India**.
 
• The Bhakra Canal System **provides an irrigation facility to 27.41 hectares of land in Haryana, Punjab, and Rajasthan**. ​
